newsitem.title: UK: UK MPs debate devolution referendums next week.
newsitem.headline: UK MPs debate devolution referendums next week.

text.p: The British parliament will debate the second reading of the bill for referendums in Scotland and Wales on the government's devolution proposals next week, leader of the House Ann Taylor said on Thursday.
The bill will be the first to be considered by the new parliament when it is debated on Wednesday and Thursday of next week. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
